topic: free claude plugin that runs a full seo audit of any website
hook: Send this to anyone paying for an SEO audit. Claude does it free.
caption:
Comment AUDIT and I'll DM you the link and how I set it up. Follow first so the DM doesn't land in requests.

Free SEO audit. Inside Claude Code.

It's an open source plugin: you hand it a website and a team of specialist agents checks speed, mobile, schema, local SEO on Google Maps, and how AI search tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity see the page, then it gives you 1 plan sorted by what matters most.

I run it on every site before I touch a line of code. Takes about 15 minutes.

#aitools #artificialintelligence #claudeai #codingtips #claudecode
